text:
Leah (PMM): short thread  We need a rapid battlecard iterate + two short launch posts for the webinar next Thursday. Goal: defensible, probe-proof claims vs cloud providers and infra vendors.
Omar (Growth): landing headline A/B ready? I want one "value" opener and one "tradeoff" opener for ads vs email.
Zoe (Field): reps want one-line returns for pricing, SLA, and migration effort. Keep them <12 words.
Dev (Bench): top bench bullets I can share: p95 kept <140ms at 1.5K rps in our harness; batching + KV cache produced ~3x token efficiency for multi-turn; fallback policy restored capacity during node failure tests.
Marta (Content): public phrasing: use "customer-observed" and keep exact harness details in gated deck. Field battlecard can call out numbers and include a 1-slide prompt example.
Kai (Sales Ops): routing rule suggestion: if company_size > 750 OR budget_est > 150k => AE; if clicked benchmark_slide => tag benchmark_hot; track opener_variant.
Leah (PMM): proposed public lines:
- "Customer-observed p95 < 140ms under sustained load"
- "Measured token savings of up to 3x for multi-turn chat with batching + caching"
- "Single API across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments"
Zoe (Field): internal 1-liners for reps:
- Latency: "Ask for benchmark deck  one slide: p95 < 140ms"
- Cost: "We routinely see ~3x cost improvements for chat-heavy flows"
- Migration: "Same API — lift-and-shift of prompts, not infra rewrite"
Marta (Content): rebuttal drafts (short):
- "Why not just use managed cloud endpoints?" -> "They give access but not deterministic economics or tail protection. Redwood provides capacity controls, routing fallbacks, and caching to keep costs and latency predictable."
- "Won't owning the model fix this?" -> "Model choice helps accuracy; serving/runtime fixes latency, cost, and reliability. We manage serving across environments so you don't rebuild infra."
Omar (Growth): headline variants:
A) "Stabilize latency and cut per-token cost: a practical playbook"
B) "Why managed endpoints fall short for production LLM features"
Decision: Run A in paid social, B in nurture emails. Tag clicks with opener=A.
Dev (Bench): deliverable: 2-slide benchmark summary + appendix with harness notes (due 3933330300).
Marta (Content): deliverable: 1-page internal battlecard + 6 rebuttals + 3 demo soundbites (due 3933330450).
Kai (Sales Ops): I'll implement SFDC routing & tag automation (due 3933330500).
Leah (PMM): add a single anonymized prompt example comparing Redwood vs a cloud endpoint for the webinar slide. Keep it gated.
Zoe (Field): reps want a 3-bullet SDR playbook for pricing pushback. Marta, can you keep it to 3 bullets?
Marta (Content): yes. I'll add a "quick revert" and a CTA to request the benchmark deck.
infra-bot: artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-assets/webinars/393333/bench-summary.pdf at 3933330255
Leah (PMM): cadence: check-in in 6h. Move fast, keep public claims conservative and field claims sharp. :rocket:
